summary.sourceIntegrity: All source raster SHA-256 hashes, dimensions, and inventory unchanged.
summary.metricMethod: 8x8 block luminance SSIM and RGB PSNR after sRGB conversion, gray compositing for alpha, maximum 1600 px comparison width. Acceptance: SSIM >= 0.99 and PSNR >= 38 dB. Native dimensions preferred; only sources wider than 3200 px are eligible for 3200/2560 px width candidates. No crops or aspect-ratio changes beyond integer pixel rounding.
